findings.f_method: Identify which registered endpoint occupies the success-determining slot for THIS catalyst (the registered PRIMARY whose timeFrame aligns with the catalyst readout), then test whether the marketed success-basis endpoint is that one. Two axes are independent: efficacy-vs-safety (what it measures) and primary-vs-secondary (its hierarchy slot). A secondary endpoint can be a legitimate efficacy endpoint — describing one is NOT masking. Also inspect version HISTORY for a CONSTRUCT/TYPE change of the registered primary near readout.
findings.m_source: ClinicalTrials.gov registration + version history
findings.rationale: The claim describes the trial's registered primary endpoint. NCT03185013's primary outcome was 'Percentage of Participants With No Evidence of Cervical HSIL on Histology and No Evidence of HPV-16 and/or HPV-18 in Cervical Samples' at Week 36, which matches the construct of 'lesion regression and viral clearance.' The primary_endpoint_timeline shows this construct remained unchanged from version 0 (2017-06-09) through all subsequent versions. No construct or type change occurred.
findings.m_evidence: NCT03185013 primary_outcomes[0]: 'Percentage of Participants With No Evidence of Cervical HSIL on Histology and No Evidence of HPV-16 and/or HPV-18 in Cervical Samples' timeFrame 'Week 36'; primary_endpoint_timeline shows single version (v0, 2017-06-09) with identical construct, no modifications through cutoff.

findings.subject: VGX-3100 + electroporation
findings.R_source_quote: As in REVEAL1, VGX-3100 was well-tolerated in REVEAL2. There were no treatment-related serious adverse events and most adverse events were considered to be mild to moderate.
findings.f_method: Compare safety framing to registered adverse-event/serious-AE data and any FDA holds; flag downplayed SAEs or discontinuations.
findings.m_source: CT.gov results adverse-events module; OpenFDA enforcement; FDA holds
findings.rationale: The claim asserts VGX-3100 was well-tolerated in REVEAL2 (NCT03185013) with no treatment-related SAEs and mostly mild-to-moderate AEs. The authoritative source shows NCT03185013 includes a secondary outcome measuring 'Number of Participants With Any Adverse Events (AEs) and Serious Adverse Events (SAEs)' but provides no results data on SAE counts, discontinuations, or FDA holds as of the filing date (2023-03-01). Topline safety results are not posted to CT.gov until after readout, so absence of contradictory data is expected, not evidence of contradiction.
findings.m_evidence: NCT03185013 secondary_outcomes includes 'Number of Participants With Any Adverse Events (AEs) and Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) Following Investigational Treatment for the Duration of the Study'; no results data present in M; overall_status='COMPLETED' as of 2023-07-24 snapshot.

findings.f_method: Compare claimed enrollment/status to CT.gov registered enrollment count and overall status as-of cutoff.
findings.m_source: ClinicalTrials.gov status + enrollment
findings.rationale: The claim asserts a financial statement ('lower clinical study expenses related to VGX-3100') which is an accounting judgment by the sponsor, not a fact registered on CT.gov. The enrollment_consistency rule compares claimed enrollment/status to registered values; this claim makes no enrollment or status assertion about NCT03721978.
findings.m_evidence: Rule scope: 'Compare claimed enrollment/status to CT.gov registered enrollment count and overall status.' Claim content: financial expense commentary with no enrollment or trial status assertion.
